title: Neon night
line: An arc around your subject in cyan and magenta neon, cut with a glitch title.

motion.prompt: Night falls into a neon-lit scene: cyan and magenta light glows and reflects across every surface, a faint haze hangs in the air and signs flicker softly. Keep the main subject recognizable, sharp and true to the photo. No hands, people, text or logos enter the frame.
